items.title: ExxonMobil (XOM) Pauses Work On Its Texas Hydrogen Facility
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (NYSE:XOM) has paused work on its planned Texas hydrogen facility, signaling a rethink of the project timetable. The move comes as U.S. hydrogen hub plans face slower progress tied to weak offtake demand and uncertain federal funding support. The Texas pause adds fresh questions around ExxonMobil's low carbon ambitions and the pace at which its hydrogen portfolio may develop. items.title: Ondo tops $4B and tokenizes Anthropic as tZERO eyes $350M SPAC
items.summary: Tokenization is moving to the center of Wall Street. On this episode of CoinDesk’s Public Keys from the New York Stock Exchange, Jennifer Sanasie is joined by Ondo Finance Global Head of Institutional Matthieu de Vergnes who explains how Ondo became No. 1 on RWA.xyz with more than $4 billion in real-world assets. Plus, he provides a look at how Ondo plans to give global investors access to Anthropic stock on IPO day. Next, Securitize Chief Operating Officer Billy Miller breaks down the firm’s expansion to 25 tokenized U.S. stocks on Solana, including Disney, ExxonMobil and GameStop, and tZERO CEO Alan Konevsky unpacks the firm’s plan to go public through a $350 million SPAC deal.
